description: SS4.3: the model is never allowed to produce a missing_document finding itself -- that kind is computed deterministically from compliance_rules vs. actual uploaded documents (lib/inngest/functions/audit.ts's computeMissingDocumentFindings), not by the model. Even a structurally well-formed one is rejected.

rawFinding.issue: The model attempted to report a missing document itself.
rawFinding.action_required: N/A -- this finding should be rejected before it reaches a human.
